mapper.select:
WITH STOCK AS ( SELECT s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd ,s.item_type_cd ,s.item_cd ,s.item_name ,s.test_no ,s.qty FROM dbo.fn_get_stock( CAST(#{stdDate} AS DATE) ,#{areaCd} ,NULL ,#{itemTypeCd} ,#{itemCd} ,#{itemName} ,#{type} ,NULL ) s )
,SAFE_STOCK AS ( SELECT d.item_cd ,MAX(ISNULL(d.safe_stock_qty, 0)) AS safeStockQty FROM dbo.tb_item_detail d GROUP BY d.item_cd ) ,PUR_ORDER AS ( SELECT b.item_cd ,SUM(ISNULL(b.qty, 0)) AS inReQty FROM dbo.tb_pur_order_mst a INNER JOIN dbo.tb_pur_order_item b ON a.pur_order_id = b.pur_order_id WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(a.end_yn)) = 'N' GROUP BY b.item_cd ) SELECT s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd ,s.item_type_cd ,s.item_cd ,s.item_name ,s.test_no ,s.qty ,ISNULL(p.inReQty, 0) AS inReQty ,ISNULL(sf.safeStockQty, 0) AS safeStockQty FROM STOCK s LEFT JOIN SAFE_STOCK sf ON s.item_cd = sf.item_cd LEFT JOIN PUR_ORDER p ON s.item_cd = p.item_cd ORDER BY s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd, s.item_cd
SELECT s.area_cd ,s.storage_cd ,s.item_type_cd ,s.item_cd ,s.item_name ,s.test_no ,s.qty ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS inReQty ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS safeStockQty FROM STOCK s ORDER BY s.item_cd, s.test_no
OPTION (RECOMPILE)

select s.test_no as testNo ,( select min(tran_date) as tran_date from tb_inv_tran_mst where tran_id in ( select tran_id from tb_inv_tran_item where test_no = s.test_no ) and tran_type_cd ='A' ) as inDate ,s.storage_cd as storageCd ,SUM(s.qty) as qty ,b.expiry_date as expiryDate from dbo.fn_get_stock( COALESCE(TRY_CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{stdDate} AS NVARCHAR(20)), '') AS DATE),CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) -- 재고 기준일 ,#{areaCd} -- 공장 (NULL: 전체) ,NULL -- 창고 (NULL: 전체) ,NULL -- 품목구분 ,#{itemCd} -- 품목코드 ,NULL -- 품목명 ,'TEST' -- ITEM / TEST ,NULL -- 거래유형 (전체) ) s join tb_item_test_no b on b.test_no = s.test_no group by s.test_no,s.storage_cd, b.expiry_date order by s.test_no ASC, inDate ASC

select a.item_cd ,b.item_name ,a.expiry_date ,a.test_no ,DATEDIFF(DAY, #{stdDate}, a.expiry_date) AS remaining_day ,c.customer_name ,a.create_date ,avg(b.in_price) as in_price ,isnull(sum(d.qty), 0) as qty ,isnull(sum(d.qty* b.in_price ), 0) as totPrice from tb_item_test_no a inner join tb_item_mst b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd left outer join tb_customer c on c.customer_cd = a.customer_cd left outer join vw_inv_stock_tran d on d.test_no = a.test_no where a.item_type_cd IN ( 'M2', 'M7')
AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 3, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 3, #{stdDate}) AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 6, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 6, #{stdDate}) AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 12, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 12, #{stdDate}) AND a.expiry_date < DATEADD(MONTH, 24, #{stdDate})
AND a.expiry_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, 24, #{stdDate})
AND a.area_cd LIKE '%' + #{areaCd} + '%'
AND a.item_cd LIKE '%' + #{itemCd} + '%'
AND b.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', dbo.fn_LikeEscape(#{itemName}), '%')
group by a.item_cd, b.item_name, a.expiry_date, a.test_no, c.customer_name, a.create_date order by a.item_cd, a.test_no
